author: Stahly
description:
Make your new Starcraft army ready to deploy in no time! In this tutorial, I'll show you how to paint Terran Marines in the box-art blue of Raynor's Raiders quickly and effectively using an airbrush and scale modelling products like enamel washes. And as a bonus guide, I'll explain how to enhance effect parts like muzzle flashes and crystals without losing the transparent effect.

The post Tutorial: How to paint Starcraft Marines (and their transparent effect pieces) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Tutorial: How to paint Starcraft Marines (and their transparent effect pieces)
